// ─── 模板：新遗物 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 用法：复制此文件，替换类名，填充逻辑。
// 检查清单（提交前逐项过）：
//   [ ] 类名格式：ShunMod{功能描述}
//   [ ] [RelicPool(typeof(池类型))] — SharedRelicPool / BossRelicPool / ShopRelicPool 等
//   [ ] 继承 ShunRelicModel<自身类>
//   [ ] 命名空间：ShunMod.Shun.Relics
//   [ ] 本地化键：SHUN_MOD_{大写下划线名}.title / .description / .flavor
//   [ ] 本地化文件：ShunMod.Shun/assets/localization/eng+zhs/relics.json
//   [ ] 图片资源：ShunMod.Shun/assets/images/<relic_icon>.png
//   [ ] git commit + push

using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Commands;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Entities.Players;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Entities.Relics;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Helpers;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.RelicPools;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Rewards;
using MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Rooms;
using ShunMod.Core.Core.Registry;
using ShunMod.Core.Base;

// ReSharper disable UnusedType.Global — 游戏框架反射使用
// ReSharper disable UnusedType.Instantiation — 游戏框架反射实例化
namespace ShunMod.Shun.Relics;

/// <summary>
///     {功能描述} — {一句话说明效果}。
/// </summary>
[RelicPool(typeof(SharedRelicPool))]
public sealed class ShunModYourRelicName : ShunRelicModel<ShunModYourRelicName>
{
    public override RelicRarity Rarity => RelicRarity.Rare;
    // RelicRarity.Rare / Uncommon / Common / Special / Boss / Starter

    // 常用覆写方法：
    //   override Task AfterPlayerTurnStart(PlayerChoiceContext, Player) — 回合开始
    //   override Task AfterPlayerTurnEnd(PlayerChoiceContext, Player) — 回合结束
    //   override bool TryModifyRewards(Player, List<Reward>, AbstractRoom?) — 战利品修改
    //   override bool TryModifyRewardsPostCombat(Player, List<Reward>) — 战后战利品

    public override bool TryModifyRewards(Player player, List<Reward> rewards, AbstractRoom? room)
    {
        if (player != Owner || room is not { RoomType: RoomType.Boss })
            return false;

        Flash();

        // ── 遗物效果逻辑写这里 ──
        // Flash() — 遗物闪烁动画
        // CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp(Owner.Creature, amount) — 增加最大生命
        // PotionFactory.CreateRandomPotionOutOfCombat(...) — 生成药水
        // GoldCmd.Add(...) — 加金币
        // CardCmd.CreateCardReward(...) — 卡牌奖励

        return false; // 返回 false 表示不阻止原有奖励
    }
}
